# The Print Planet — Complete Knowledge Base & Wholesale Product Catalog

## Organization Overview
The Print Planet (operating online at https://theprintplanet.co.in) is India's premier B2B manufacturer, direct importer, and wholesale distributor specializing in ID card production machinery, identity accessories, lanyard materials, and smart access cards. Based in Sunkadakatte, Bengaluru, the company serves over 500+ commercial clients nationwide including print bureaus, universities, government bodies, IT enterprises, and security integrators.

## Detailed Wholesale Product Categories

### 1. Satin Lanyard Rolls (Sublimation & Screen Printing)
- **Indian Satin Lanyard Rolls:** 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm widths. High tensile strength, smooth finish, optimal for direct screen printing and heat press.
- **White Digital Lanyard Rolls (Sublimation Grade):** Ultra-white, high-density weave specifically calibrated for edge-to-edge sublimation ribbon printing with accurate Pantone color reproduction.
- **Packaging:** Spool packaging in 50-meter, 100-meter, and 500-meter continuous lengths.

### 2. PVC ID Card Holders & Badges
- **Crystal Clear Rigid PVC Holders:** Heavy-duty transparent sleeves that maintain rigidity and clarity in high-wear corporate and campus environments.
- **Semi-Transparent Frosted Holders:** Soft-touch matte holders with thumb-slot ejection for convenient access card swiping.
- **Orientations:** Vertical (Portrait) 54x86mm standard ISO card size; Horizontal (Landscape) 86x54mm.
- **Sticker Pasting Badges & Dual Card Holders:** Multi-compartment units suitable for holding both a visual photo badge and an RFID proximity card.

### 3. Lanyard Hardware, Clips & Attachments
- **Dog Hooks & Oval Fish Hooks:** Nickel-plated and antique brass alloy metal clips with 360-degree swivel mechanism to prevent lanyard twisting.
- **Crocodile / Alligator Clips:** Secure teeth grip clips with clear vinyl strap.
- **Safety Breakaway Clasps:** Quick-release plastic buckles that detach under heavy tension to prevent workplace strangulation accidents.
- **Ribbon Crimp Clamps:** Stamped metal clips for crimping loop ends securely.

### 4. ID Card Manufacturing & Finishing Machinery
- **Motorized Electric PVC ID Card Die Cutters:** Industrial-grade desktop electric cutting units that punch individual CR-80 (85.6mm x 54mm) cards with precision rounded corners from laminated sheets with high cycle speed.
- **Automatic & Manual PVC Card Fusing Laminators:** Dual-plate heated press laminators designed to fuse inkjet printable PVC core sheets with coated magnetic/RFID overlay films without air bubbles or delamination.
- **Manual Slot & Round Hole Punches:** Heavy-gauge steel hand tools for punching lanyard oval slots and round holes into finished cards.

### 5. RFID Smart Cards & Consumables
- **Mifare 1K Classic ISO Cards (13.56MHz):** High-frequency contactless smart cards with 1KB EEPROM memory for campus attendance, transit, and cashless canteen systems.
- **EM-Marin Proximity Cards (125kHz):** Standard clamshell and thin ISO proximity cards for building access control and turnstiles.
- **Prelam Sheets & Coated Overlays:** 0.76mm PVC inkjet sheets and magnetic stripe overlay film packs for ID card manufacturers.

- **How to Order:** Direct enquiries via the online quotation portal at https://theprintplanet.co.in/quote or WhatsApp at +91 97418 08034.
- **Turnaround Time:** Quotations provided within 1 working hour. Orders dispatched within 24 to 48 hours.

- **Taxation:** 100% compliant with GST guidelines; formal tax invoices provided with every consignment for input tax credit claims.
